countries.reasoning: Based on USGS and industry reports for 2022-2023, China is the dominant producer of silicon dioxide with extensive mining operations. Data is recent and from authoritative sources, hence high confidence.
USGS 2023 data indicates that the US is a significant producer of silica sands and quartz. Reliable government statistics support this estimate.
Indian geological surveys and mining reports show strong quartz and silica sand production. Data is solid but somewhat less detailed than China and US.
Brazilian mining ministry data supports its position as a key producer of high-purity quartz. Confidence is moderate due to less frequent reporting.
Australian industry reports and government data confirm steady silica production. Data is reliable but not as comprehensive as China or US.
